title: Umami X-tra Juicy Jamaican Meat Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful, slow-cooked Jamaican meat stew featuring a blend of earthy spices and a hint of tamasic energy. Serve with steamed rice or roti for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: 2 lbs beef or pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with good marbling for maximum umami flavor

ingredients.name: 2 medium onions, chopped
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of yellow and red onions for added sweetness

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Mince garlic just before adding to the pot to preserve its flavor and aroma

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon five spice powder
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free soy sauce for vegetarian options

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Balance the savory flavors with a touch of sweetness

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Warm and comforting, adds depth to the stew

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon ground cumin
ingredients.notes: Earthly and savory, pairs well with beef and pork

ingredients.name: 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a touch of heat to balance the flavors

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free flour for vegetarian options

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a neutral-tasting oil for saut	8ing the meat

ingredients.name: 2 cups beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium broth for a lighter flavor

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the meat from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the onions, cooking until they're softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, five spice powder, soy sauce, brown sugar, cinnamon, cumin, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Return the meat to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling apart.
Deglaze the pot with a spoon, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
